name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd
tagline: High-growth fintech-SaaS spend-management platform, but growth has decelerated sharply (40-45% -> 28% YoY), margins compressed a third straight quarter, and cash conversion (receivables Rs 40cr -> 129cr) stays unresolved - conviction Low
business_overview: B2B spend-management / employee-benefits SaaS (Zaggle Save, Propel, expense management) for enterprises; grows via direct sales plus acquisitions (Dice, Unobanc stake). Revenue mix is low-margin program/interchange fees plus higher-margin SaaS/Propel.
fundamentals_table: Rev Rs 1,908 Cr +46%, adj EBITDA Rs 192 Cr +51%, PAT Rs 139 Cr +52%
5-yr Zaggle Save with Crompton Greaves Consumer; 5-yr HPCL Driver Track Plus (fleet); both usage-linked, value not quantified
fundamentals_narrative: FY26 was a record year (revenue +46%, adj EBITDA +51%, PAT +52%) but Q1 FY27 marks a clear inflection down: revenue growth slowed to 28% YoY (program-fee growth just ~10%), PAT fell 33% YoY and adjusted EBITDA margin compressed to 8.2% (from 10.1%), which management attributes to one-time Dice acquisition costs, moderated capitalisation and employee increments. Management nonetheless reaffirms ~40% consolidated growth guidance for FY27, leaning on Dice revenue and cash-flow optimisation. Trade receivables rose from ~Rs 40 Cr to ~Rs 129 Cr YoY and operating cash conversion remains the key unresolved concern from the prior read. Almost debt-free; no dividend despite consistent profitability. Valuation has de-rated to ~18.7x TTM P/E. Crompton Greaves and HPCL 5-year deals are genuine logo wins but carry no determinable contract value.
sentiment_summary: One new post (#448, shyamutty, elevated tier): Vijay Kedia's Kedia Securities bought ~20 lakh shares via a bulk deal at ~Rs 164.72 - a marquee-investor entry, reported not endorsed. Otherwise the prior debate (cash flow, receivables, disclosure quality, FII exits) stands, now reinforced by the Q1 FY27 deceleration.
community_signal: shyamutty (elevated) flagged the Kedia bulk deal without a personal call. No trusted-roster buy conviction; prior concerns from firefueled / anna / rosenmund remain on the table.
key_new_facts: Q1 FY27: revenue Rs 423 Cr (+28% YoY, decelerating from 40-45%; program-fee growth only ~10%), PAT Rs 17.5 Cr (-33% YoY), adj EBITDA margin 8.2% (from 10.1%), blamed on one-time Dice acquisition costs + moderated capitalisation + increments.
Management reaffirmed ~40% consolidated revenue growth guidance for FY27 despite the Q1 slowdown, dependent on Dice contribution and cash-flow optimisation.
New: 5-yr HPCL Driver Track Plus fleet program and 5-yr Crompton Greaves Consumer Zaggle Save agreement - both usage/spend-linked, contract value 'cannot be determined'.
FY26 full year: revenue Rs 1,908 Cr (+46%), adj EBITDA Rs 192 Cr (+51%), PAT Rs 139 Cr (+52%); trade receivables up ~Rs 40 Cr -> ~Rs 129 Cr YoY.
Valuation de-rated to ~18.7x TTM P/E (mcap ~Rs 2,420 Cr); promoter ~44.3% stable, pledge negligible (~0.36%).
Kedia Securities acquired ~20 lakh shares via bulk deal (~Rs 164.72 avg).
bull_case: Revenue still compounding ~28% off a large structural enterprise spend-management / SaaS niche; 3-yr sales CAGR ~51%
Valuation has de-rated to ~18.7x TTM P/E - the thesis is not priced in at this multiple
Marquee logo additions (Crompton Greaves, HPCL 5-yr) and marquee-investor entry (Kedia Securities)
Almost debt-free; AI 'Zaggle Brain' driving ~12.5% cost optimisation per management
No formal AVOID/EXCLUDE red flag; promoter holding stable, pledge negligible
bear_case: Growth decelerated hard in Q1 FY27 (40-45% -> 28%; program fees +10% only) - the compounding narrative is now in question
Third consecutive quarter of profit pressure; Q1 FY27 PAT -33% YoY even if partly one-off
Cash conversion and rising receivables (Rs 40cr -> 129cr) remain unaddressed; no dividend despite profits
Growth has leaned on acquisitions (Dice, Unobanc); organic quality less clear
Crompton / HPCL deals have no quantifiable value; historic FII holder attrition; disclosure-quality concerns from prior reads
verdict_headline: Deep-dive pass 1: valuation has de-rated to ~18.7x and the structural niche is intact, but Q1 FY27 shows growth decelerating to 28% with a third straight quarter of margin/profit pressure and unresolved cash conversion - thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years (unconfirmed) kept on valuation carve-out, conviction Low, unchanged
verdict_reasoning: four_box score 3.0: tailwind yes (structural enterprise spend-management adoption), tam yes (large under-penetrated market, revenue still ~28%), moat no (no durable switching cost demonstrated; logo wins unquantified), valuation yes (~18.7x TTM P/E is not pricing in the growth). Valuation-box=yes is the written exception that keeps the 10x label live at 2.0-2.5-equivalent underlying quality.

Q1 FY27 (revenue +28% vs 40-45% prior, program fee +10%, PAT -33% YoY, margin 8.2%) confirms rather than dispels the execution-quality and cash-conversion concerns from the prior read, even allowing for one-time Dice costs. Management's reaffirmed ~40% FY27 guidance is an expectation with no evidenced backing yet.

No change: thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years kept as unconfirmed on the small-cap size, structural niche and de-rated multiple; conviction Low given decelerating growth, three quarters of margin compression, and unresolved receivables / cash conversion. Kedia Securities' bulk-deal entry is a mild offsetting positive. No red flag; no 30-day revisit.

annual_report_findings: FY26: consolidated revenue Rs 1,908 Cr (+46.3%), adjusted EBITDA Rs 192 Cr (+51%), PAT Rs 139 Cr (+52%) - record year on all metrics.
Trade receivables rose from ~Rs 40 Cr to ~Rs 129 Cr YoY; operating cash conversion vs EBITDA remains weak and is the recurring red thread across reads.
Balance sheet almost debt-free (borrowings ~Rs 55 Cr, Mar 2026); no dividend declared despite consistent profitability.
Growth model mixes organic direct sales with acquisitions (Dice consolidated FY26/27, Unobanc stake) - inorganic contribution material to the headline rate.
Promoter holding stable ~44.3%; promoter group (RAN Ventures) made small open-market top-ups in FY26; pledge negligible (~0.36%).
quarterly_trend: Q3 FY26: revenue +~48% YoY - peak growth quarter.
Q4 FY26: revenue ~Rs 618 Cr, strong; FY26 exit run-rate high.
Q1 FY27: revenue Rs 423 Cr, +28% YoY (sequential decline vs Q4), program-fee growth only ~10%.
Q1 FY27: PAT Rs 17.5 Cr, -33% YoY; adj EBITDA margin 8.2% vs 10.1% YoY - third consecutive quarter of profit/margin pressure.
Management call tone: defensive on margin (one-offs) but reaffirmed ~40% FY27 growth guidance.
recent_announcements: 5-year Zaggle Save agreement with Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals - usage/spend-linked, value not determinable.
5-year HPCL Driver Track Plus fleet program - new fleet-business revenue stream, value not quantified.
Kedia Securities (Vijay Kedia) acquired ~20 lakh shares via bulk deal at ~Rs 164.72.
Dice acquisition costs (transaction fees, vendor payments, relocation) flowed through Q1 FY27 P&L as one-offs.
'Zaggle Brain' AI platform (patent-pending) cited for ~12.5% cost optimisation.
key_new_facts: Growth rate halved sequentially (40-45% -> 28%); program-fee line, the volume engine, grew only ~10%.
Third straight quarter of margin compression; Q1 FY27 adj EBITDA margin 8.2%.
Receivables Rs 40cr -> 129cr YoY; cash conversion still the central unresolved question.
Valuation de-rated to ~18.7x TTM P/E from a much richer multiple at listing.
Two 5-year enterprise deals signed but neither carries a determinable contract value.
open_questions: Is the Q1 FY27 deceleration a one-quarter Dice-integration air-pocket or a structural step-down in the growth rate?
When does operating cash flow converge to reported EBITDA, and why has the receivables build not reversed?
How much of FY26/FY27 growth is organic vs acquired (Dice, Unobanc)?
Why no dividend or buyback despite three years of profitability and a near-debt-free balance sheet?
deep_dive.conviction_update: Low -> Low. The valuation de-rating and intact structural niche keep the 10x label alive on a carve-out, but Q1 FY27's sharp growth deceleration, third straight quarter of margin pressure and unresolved cash conversion confirm the prior concerns rather than dispelling them.

earnings_quality.normalised_note: Reported adj EBITDA margin has compressed for three straight quarters to 8.2%; this is below, not above, a defensible through-cycle level (~10-11%). The risk here is margins staying depressed, not mean-reverting down from a peak.
